stock.description: Strong Petrochemical Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company, primarily engaged in the trading of various commodities. Its portfolio of traded goods includes crude oil, refined petroleum products, petrochemicals, coal, and iron ore. Beyond its core trading business, the company also provides storage and related ancillary services for petroleum and petrochemical substances, and actively participates in property investment ventures. The firm's market presence extends across the People's Republic of China, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Macao. Established in 1999, its principal office is located in Admiralty, Hong Kong.
